name: Sofitel Baru Calablanca Beach Resort
positioning: Beach resort on the white sands of Isla Baru, officially Sofitel Baru Cartagena Beach Resort, with LEED-certified design inspired by the local biodiversity
best_for: Couples wanting a suite with a private sea-view terrace and jacuzzi
Families who need space, from crib-ready family rooms to Caribbean Family Penthouses
Travelers who care about locally inspired design and sustainability credentials

facts.text: The resort is set on the white-sand beaches of Isla Baru on Colombia's Caribbean coast.
Rooms look out over gardens and the Caribbean waters of Isla Baru.
Rooms feature accents of stone and exotic wood, with a color palette that evokes the Colombian seaside and landscape.
Superior Rooms have a private balcony with a tropical garden view and L'Occitane bath amenities.
Junior Suites have a private balcony with a panoramic Caribbean Sea view.
The Emerald Ocean Suite has a spacious private terrace with a Jacuzzi.
The Presidential Ocean View Penthouse sits on the rooftop of Block 10.
The Presidential Ocean View Penthouse has a dedicated butler kitchen.
Family rooms offer space for a crib and additional baby furniture.
Suite guests can ask about an exclusive gastronomic breakfast experience.
The resort holds Green Key Certification for 2026 for sustainability and environmental care.

highlights.text: Rooms feature a hand-stitched tapestry by Colombian artist Eloin Rivera, inspired by mangroves, birds and the colors of the Caribbean.
The resort has LEED certification, and its design draws inspiration from the surrounding biodiversity, using natural materials.
The Presidential Ocean View Penthouse has a private terrace with a jacuzzi and panoramic sea views.
Caribbean Family Penthouses have a private terrace with a jacuzzi overlooking the Caribbean Sea.
Signature King Beach Front rooms have a private balcony with front-facing views of the Caribbean.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the remote island location means a transfer from Cartagena.
The gastronomic breakfast for suite guests is arranged on inquiry.
